_provenance.what: g1 of the deuteron (g1d), per nucleon, copied VERBATIM from the nnpdf-data wheel by validation/benchmarks/vendor_nnpdf_commondata.py; nothing is transformed

source.files_read_note: every wheel member this script read (path inside the wheel -> sha256 hex), each checked against the wheel's RECORD; the ones not vendored are named in 'not_vendored'

_provenance.paper: K. Abe et al. (E143), Phys. Rev. D 58 (1998) 112003, hep-ph/9802357 (as survey row D-6 cites it).  CONFLICT, UNRESOLVED OFFLINE: metadata.yaml's arXiv field is hep-ex/9705012, not hep-ph/9802357, beside INSPIRE 467140 / HEPData ins467140; which paper table 18 belongs to could not be checked.

licence.data: CC0-1.0: HEPData records are released under CC0, and these numbers are NNPDF's copy of the HEPData record named in 'record'
licence.package: GPL-3.0-or-later (the wheel's METADATA 'License' field), the same licence as LiPolGen

publishing_convention.normalisation: PER NUCLEON: NNPDF's y_label for the set is 'g_{1,N}(x, Q^2)' (metadata.yaml), and 06_critic.md sec. 5.1 lists g1d as per nucleon for HERMES, COMPASS and E143.  The paper's own statement is UNVERIFIED offline.
publishing_convention.d_state: UNVERIFIED.  metadata.yaml does not say whether the published g1d is corrected for the deuteron D state.  06_critic.md sec. 5.1 (the g1d row, line 524): 'published g1d is conventionally NOT corrected for the D state; the (1 - 1.5 omega_D) factor is applied when extracting g1n. Applying it twice, or not at all, is a 7 % error on the isoscalar combination. Verify per paper.'  The paper could not be read here, so the harness reports the tree's convention (g1_nucleus(deuteron)/2, which carries 1 - 1.5 P_D) AND the no-D-state variant (g1p + g1n)/2.
publishing_convention.q2: Each point is at its own <Q^2> (the kinematics 'mid' value); no evolution to a common Q^2 is stated in the source (UNVERIFIED).
publishing_convention.beam: 28 points at Q^2 = 1.27-9.52 GeV^2; which E143 beam energy (29.1 / 16.2 / 9.7 GeV) they are from is not stated (UNVERIFIED).
publishing_convention.sys_beam: 'systematic uncertainty due to beam Normalization' (MULT, CORR): 4.9 % of the central value, signed with it, in every bin.
publishing_convention.uncertainty_labels: ADD/MULT and CORR/UNCORR are NNPDF's treatment labels in the commondata files, copied verbatim; they are NNPDF's reading of the HEPData record, not the collaboration's words.  Uncertainties are ABSOLUTE (same units as the central value), as given; a MULT component is the relative error already multiplied by the central value.

_provenance.body_sha256_rule: sha256 of json.dumps(body, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False).encode('ascii')
